notes:
This release fixes OPTiC gradually locking up on a busy machine.

After a while the app could stop answering - pages opening empty, buttons doing nothing, and the window refusing to close - until it was restarted. There were four separate causes and all of them are fixed. Under the same load that used to stall a request for twenty-eight seconds, the slowest now takes under three tenths of a second.

Closing the window is immediate again, and a single slow request can no longer silence the rest of the page.

Nothing you need to do after updating.
